description: S1 Policy steering approach. Paper S1 (policy steering): restricted technologies (sustainable subset), sector policies + carbon price, no behavioural change. Default design: EU residual emissions of 200 Mt CO2eq/yr in 2050 (relaxed from net zero, paper Results p.~3), global 500 Gt CO2 budget from 2018 (1.5 C). Region EUR = EU27 + UK (flag: EU28, not EU27). Base years 2015 and 2020 present (2020 is model output, identical across runs). AI-compiled, pending Secretariat verification.

S2 Behavioral approach. Paper S2 (behavioural): restricted technologies, sector policies, behavioural change. Default design: 200 Mt CO2eq/yr residual in 2050, 1.5 C global budget. Region EUR = EU27 + UK (flag: EU28, not EU27). Base years 2015 and 2020 present (2020 is model output, identical across runs). AI-compiled, pending Secretariat verification.

S3 Technology-oriented approach. Paper S3 (technology-oriented): full technology set, sector policies, no behavioural change. Default design: 200 Mt CO2eq/yr residual in 2050, 1.5 C global budget. Region EUR = EU27 + UK (flag: EU28, not EU27). Base years 2015 and 2020 present (2020 is model output, identical across runs). AI-compiled, pending Secretariat verification.

S4 Acceptance-oriented approach. Paper S4 (acceptance-oriented): restricted technologies, carbon pricing only, no behavioural change. Default design: 200 Mt CO2eq/yr residual in 2050, 1.5 C global budget. Region EUR = EU27 + UK (flag: EU28, not EU27). Base years 2015 and 2020 present (2020 is model output, identical across runs). AI-compiled, pending Secretariat verification.

Region EUR = EU27 + UK (flag: EU28, not EU27). Base years 2015 and 2020 present (2020 is model output, identical across runs). AI-compiled, pending Secretariat verification.
